entries.corrected_exact_fragment: Pray to the Father in the power of the Spirit, in the name or by the authority and the merit of the Son.
entries.corrected_quote_ru: Молитесь Отцу силой Духа, во имя Сына или на основании власти и заслуги Сына.

entries.corrected_exact_fragment: As most of the pieces are defensive, so all of them to defend from sin, none to secure the Christian from suffering. They are to defend him in suffering, not privilege him from it.
entries.corrected_quote_ru: Большинство частей всеоружия — оружие оборонительное: они даны защищать христианина от греха, а не избавлять его от страданий. Доспехи должны защищать его в страдании, а не давать привилегию не страдать.
entries.source_location: Direction IX: suffering; defensive armour and suffering paragraph

entries.corrected_exact_fragment: There is one God, there is one Christ, the Son of God; when I say "One," I mean a union, not a confusion; the one Nature did not degenerate into the other, but was united with it. "He humbled Himself, becoming obedient unto death, yea, the death of the cross." See, says one, He voluntarily became obedient; he was not equal to Him whom He obeyed. O you obstinate ones and unwise! This does not at all lower Him. For we too become obedient to our friends, yet this has no effect. He became obedient as a Son to His Father; He fell not thus into a servile state, but by this very act above all others guarded his wondrous Sonship, by thus greatly honoring the Father.
entries.corrected_quote_ru: Христос, Сын Божий, добровольно стал послушным Отцу как Сын; это нисколько не унижает Его и не низводит в рабское состояние. Напротив, этим послушанием Он особенно явил Своё дивное Сыновство, воздав Отцу высочайшую честь.
entries.source_location: Homily 7 on Philippians, paragraphs on Philippians 2:8 and the Son's obedience
